# TotemAlchemy

## Overview

TotemAlchemy expands cauldrons and brewing stands into a discoverable survival alchemy system. Ingredients can have uncertain fusion chances and multiple valid outcomes, while successful experiments become reliable knowledge recorded in the shared Totem Manual.

## Systems

- Heated cauldron recipes for bowls, wood ash, saltpeter, gunpowder, hot cocoa, and custom brews.
- Pig manure collection and a physical resource chain for early chemical ingredients.
- Dynamic brewing where ingredient fusion and effect selection are separate rolls.
- Multi-outcome potion ingredients, including vanilla and custom effect branches.
- Cherry Swiftness and Glowgrass Strength potion families with normal extension and strengthening paths.
- Data-pack entry points for extending supported recipes and ingredients.

## Discovery

The in-game manual records discovered alchemy information instead of exposing every result immediately. This makes experimentation useful while keeping recipes inspectable after they have been learned.

All item use, cauldron state changes, timing, ingredient consumption, and brewing results are validated by the server.

## Setup

Install TotemAlchemy 0.1.22, TotemCore 0.5.0, and Fabric API on both client and server.

Do not install this standalone JAR beside DeadRecall 2.4.10; the bundle already contains the identical module.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Java 25 or newer
- Client and server required
